id_text: Jalan dulu, Nak. Lalu rumah, lalu pasar. Jangan terbalik.
en_text: Road first, dear. Then homes, then a market. Not backwards.
zh_text: 先修路，孩子。再盖房，再开市场。别弄反了。

id_text: Enam belas warga, pasar ramai. Kamu bisa juga, ya.
en_text: Sixteen people, a busy market. So you can do it, then.
zh_text: 十六位居民，市场也热闹了。你还真行。

id_text: Rob di Semarang naik terus tiap bulan. Tanggul dan pompa, Nak.
en_text: In Semarang the tide climbs higher every month. Levees and a pump, dear.
zh_text: 三宝垄的海水一个月比一个月高。堤坝和水泵，孩子。

id_text: Rob boleh datang, kaki warga tetap kering. Bagus, Nak.
en_text: Let the tide come. Everyone's feet stay dry. Well done, dear.
zh_text: 海水来就来吧，大家的脚还是干的。好样的，孩子。

id_text: Ciliwung naik dua kali, Nak. Yang pertama cuma pemanasan.
en_text: The Ciliwung rises twice, dear. The first one is only the warm-up.
zh_text: 芝利翁河要涨两次，孩子。第一次只是热身。

id_text: Dua banjir lewat, warga masih di rusun. Bandel, ya.
en_text: Two floods gone, and everyone's still in the flats. Stubborn lot.
zh_text: 两场洪水过去，大家还在公寓里。真是倔脾气。

id_text: Laut pasang, laut surut. Rumahnya jangan ikut hanyut, ya.
en_text: Tide in, tide out. Just don't let the houses drift off with it.
zh_text: 潮涨潮落。可别让房子也跟着漂走。

id_text: Tiga puluh orang tidur di atas laut. Nyenyak pula.
en_text: Thirty people asleep over the sea. Sleeping well, too.
zh_text: 三十个人睡在海面上，还睡得真香。

id_text: Tiga layangan harus tinggi. Jangan halangi anginnya, Nak.
en_text: Three kites, flying high. Don't block the wind, dear.
zh_text: 三只风筝都要飞得高。别挡了风，孩子。

id_text: Lihat itu, tiga layangan! Ibu jadi ingin ikut lari.
en_text: Look at that, three kites! Makes me want to run along.
zh_text: 快看，三只风筝！看得我都想跟着跑。

id_text: Di Bali, air dibagi bersama. Jangan ada teras yang kehausan, ya.
en_text: In Bali, water is shared. Don't leave any terrace thirsty.
zh_text: 在巴厘岛，水是大家分着用的。别让哪块梯田渴着。

id_text: Semua teras menguning bersama. Pak Pekaseh pasti ikut tersenyum.
en_text: Every terrace gold at once. The water master would be smiling.
zh_text: 梯田一起黄了。管水的老伯肯定也在笑。

id_text: Di Jogja, lindu datang tanpa kabar. Balai dan warga harus selamat.
en_text: In Jogja, the quake comes without warning. Keep the hall and everyone safe.
zh_text: 在日惹，地震不打招呼。会堂和大家都要平安。

id_text: Tanah sudah diam. Balai berdiri, warga lengkap. Alhamdulillah.
en_text: The ground is still. The hall stands, and everyone's here. Thank God.
zh_text: 地面静下来了。会堂还在，人也齐了。谢天谢地。

id_text: Lereng Toraja cantik, tapi kalau hujan suka turun. Tanam bambu, Nak.
en_text: Toraja's slopes are pretty, but they slide when soaked. Plant bamboo, dear.
zh_text: 托拉查的山坡真美，可一下雨就爱滑。种竹子吧，孩子。

id_text: Tiga puluh warga, dan lerengnya masih di tempatnya. Pintar kamu.
en_text: Thirty people, and the hill's still where it was. Clever you.
zh_text: 三十位居民，山坡也还在原地。你真聪明。

id_text: Mbah Merapi tetangga lama kita. Galak, tapi abunya menyuburkan sawah.
en_text: Old Merapi is our neighbour. Fierce, but the ash feeds the paddies.
zh_text: 默拉皮爷爷是咱们的老邻居。脾气大，可火山灰能肥田。

id_text: Panen lagi sesudah abu. Kita memang keras kepala.
en_text: Harvest again, after the ash. We really are a stubborn lot.
zh_text: 落完灰又丰收了。咱们就是这么犟。

id_text: Kalau laut surut tiba-tiba, lari ke bukit. Jangan ada yang tertinggal.
en_text: If the sea suddenly pulls back, run for the hills. Leave no one behind.
zh_text: 海水要是突然退了，就往山上跑。一个都不能落下。

id_text: Semua selamat di bukit. Hari ini, laut tidak mengambil siapa pun.
en_text: Everyone's safe on the hill. Today, the sea took no one.
zh_text: 大家都平安上了山。今天，海没有带走任何人。

id_text: Semua bencana dalam satu kota. Anu... kotanya belum punya nama.
en_text: Every disaster in one city. And, um... the city still has no name.
zh_text: 所有灾难都挤在一座城里。那个……这城还没有名字呢。

id_text: Seratus dua puluh warga. Namanya? Ah, Anu saja.
en_text: A hundred and twenty people. Its name? Oh, just Anu.
zh_text: 一百二十位居民。名字嘛？唉，就叫 Anu 吧。

id_text: Salatiga! Sejuknya Merbabu. Di rumah Ibu, jangan salah, Nak.
en_text: Salatiga! That cool Merbabu air. This is my home, dear, so no mistakes.
zh_text: 萨拉蒂加！默巴布的风真凉快。这是我的家，孩子，可别出错。

id_text: Anu? Bukan. Ini Salatiga.
en_text: Anu? No. This is Salatiga.
zh_text: Anu？不对。这里是萨拉蒂加。

id_text: Solo penuh motor, Nak. Bangun halte, motornya biar di rumah.
en_text: Solo is all mopeds, dear. Build bus stops, and leave the mopeds at home.
zh_text: 梭罗满街都是摩托，孩子。修公交站，让摩托留在家里。

id_text: Jalannya lega! Motor di rumah, warga naik bus. Tumben nurut.
en_text: The road's clear! Mopeds at home, everyone on the bus. They listened, for once.
zh_text: 路通了！摩托在家，大家坐公交。难得这么听话。

id_text: Di Tugu, kereta lewat, jalan macet. Bangun stasiun, Nak.
en_text: At Tugu, the train comes and the road jams. Build a station, dear.
zh_text: 在图古，火车一过，路就堵。修个车站吧，孩子。

id_text: Kereta jalan, mobil jalan. Jogja tidak perlu sabar lagi.
en_text: Trains moving, cars moving. Jogja can stop being patient.
zh_text: 火车在跑，汽车也在跑。日惹总算不用再等了。

id_text: Ambarawa menanjak, Nak. Rel gigi, biar keretanya tidak merosot.
en_text: Ambarawa climbs, dear. Rack rail, so the train doesn't slide back.
zh_text: 安巴拉瓦是上坡路，孩子。铺上齿轨，火车才不会往下溜。

id_text: Sampai juga di atas. Uapnya pun ikut bangga.
en_text: Up at last. Even the steam looks proud.
zh_text: 总算到顶了。连蒸汽都一脸得意。

id_text: Manggarai, Nak. Dua jalur kereta, dan banjir tetap datang.
en_text: Manggarai, dear. Two rail lines, and the flood comes anyway.
zh_text: 曼加莱，孩子。两条铁路，洪水照样来。

id_text: Banjir lewat, kereta tetap jalan. Jakarta, Ibu angkat topi.
en_text: Flood gone, trains still running. Jakarta, I take my hat off.
zh_text: 洪水退了，火车照跑。雅加达，我服了。

id_text: Nah, berdiri juga! Tidak miring pula. Ibu terkesan.
en_text: There, it's up! Not even crooked. I'm impressed.
zh_text: 瞧，立起来了！居然没歪。不错不错。

id_text: Panen pertama! Kecil sih, tapi nasinya tetap enak.
en_text: First harvest! Small, sure, but the rice still tastes good.
zh_text: 第一次丰收！是不多，可米饭照样香。

id_text: Air naik, Nak! Bukan waktunya santai.
en_text: The water's rising, dear! This is no time to relax.
zh_text: 水涨了，孩子！这可不是歇着的时候。

id_text: Tanahnya bergetar! Semua keluar dari rumah, cepat!
en_text: The ground's shaking! Everyone out of the houses, quick!
zh_text: 地在晃！大家快出屋，快！

id_text: Abu turun! Atap rumah jangan sampai ambruk, Nak.
en_text: Ash is falling! Don't let those roofs cave in, dear.
zh_text: 落灰了！可别让屋顶塌了，孩子。

when: The sea pulls back before a wave.
id_text: Laut surut! Lari ke tempat tinggi, sekarang!
en_text: The sea's pulling back! Run for high ground, now!
zh_text: 海水退了！快往高处跑，现在就跑！

when: The town does not have enough rice.
id_text: Perut warga sudah bunyi, Nak. Berasnya mana?
en_text: People's stomachs are growling, dear. Where's the rice?
zh_text: 大家的肚子都在叫了，孩子。米呢？

id_text: Ya sudah. Tarik napas dulu, lalu kita coba lagi.
en_text: Oh well. Take a breath, then we try again.
zh_text: 算了。先喘口气，咱们再来一次。

id_text: Jalan macet lagi. Ibu sampai duluan jalan kaki, Nak.
en_text: Jammed again. I'd get there first on foot, dear.
zh_text: 又堵了。我走路都比车快，孩子。
